_doc: Note bodies for r3. Header layout is bound to the r2 note format at binding time. Job ids are placeholders; the runner assigns ids consistent with the fixture block. Status lines: 'session ended <date> — job complete' or '— job blocked'. On rungs R1/R2 the runner appends the score line shown in `score_line_R1R2`. T2 bodies are SYNTHETIC TEMPLATES and are replaced by harvested gate transcripts if any READ episode occurs (AMENDMENT_r3 §2.2).
ordering: by job id ascending; identical rule in every trace condition
